lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Performance task: build: gallery entries with equal-partition evidence

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Set up the first two carefully; the rest of the build depends on them.

items.prompt: A shape is divided into 6 equal parts. 3 of the parts are shaded. What fraction of the shape is shaded?
A number line from 0 to 1 is divided into 6 equal lengths. What fraction names the point that is 1 lengths from 0?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A shape is divided into 4 equal parts. 1 of the parts are shaded. What fraction of the shape is shaded?
A number line from 0 to 1 is divided into 6 equal lengths. What fraction names the point that is 2 lengths from 0?
A shape is divided into 6 equal parts. 4 of the parts are shaded. What fraction of the shape is shaded?
A number line from 0 to 1 is divided into 6 equal lengths. What fraction names the point that is 3 lengths from 0?
A shape is divided into 6 equal parts. 5 of the parts are shaded. What fraction of the shape is shaded?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Carry the build to a result and say how you would check it is right.

items.prompt: A number line from 0 to 1 is divided into 8 equal lengths. What fraction names the point that is 4 lengths from 0?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A shape is divided into 8 equal parts. 6 of the parts are shaded. What fraction of the shape is shaded?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
